need.statement: Keep the cc-se-sto-devbox-01 Home Manager toolchain current by refreshing every floating flake input at its already-declared ref, using the newest ast-grep package available from refreshed Nixpkgs inputs, and adapting the profile to the refreshed Home Manager options.
stakeholders: Mikael using the cc-se-sto-devbox-01 Home Manager profile.
need.baseline: The active ast-grep command reports 0.42.1; upstream latest release is 0.50.0. flake.lock pins nixpkgs-unstable at 801bef6abd86b91e51083066b83fb354a11fc640 while the current branch resolves to 6510408d147d8c5e6d76043e899e9251756f6a75. alternatives_considered: Keep all existing lock revisions and package source
Refresh all floating refs and use the newest package available in the declared Nixpkgs inputs

evidence.description: Compare the locked nixpkgs-unstable revision and active ast-grep version to current upstream/Nixpkgs observations before editing.
evidence.command: ast-grep --version; nix flake metadata --json github:NixOS/nixpkgs/nixos-unstable; nix eval --raw github:NixOS/nixpkgs/nixos-unstable#ast-grep.version

evidence.description: Verify the refreshed lock, declared checks, and current devbox Home Manager activation package.
evidence.command: nix flake update; repo check; nix build .#homeConfigurations.cc-se-sto-devbox-01.activationPackage

evidence.description: Capture pre-fix Home Manager evaluation warnings for renamed Zsh options.

falsifier.claim: The refreshed flake resolves all floating inputs at declared refs, selects the newest Nixpkgs ast-grep package, and evaluates the current Home Manager profile without renamed-option warnings.

executable_check.description: Evaluate the ast-grep version selected by the proposed cc-se-sto-devbox-01 profile against the locked nixpkgs-unstable package, then build its activation package; any mismatch or build failure falsifies the claim. A live ast-grep --version readback is required only after a separately authorized profile activation.

non_goals: Change flake.nix channel/ref declarations or fixed version pins
Package upstream ast-grep source when nixpkgs does not yet provide it
Activate Home Manager profiles for other hosts
invariants: Existing flake input URLs and channel selections remain unchanged
The fixed nixpkgs-rust revision and direnv-instant version ref remain fixed
Do not activate a Home Manager generation in this source update; verify evaluation and build only

assumptions.statement: “All latest in flake” means refresh floating lock entries at existing declared refs without changing their ref declarations.
assumptions.falsifier: The user requests a different channel, tag, or immutable source revision.

assumptions.statement: The newest ast-grep package available from the refreshed Nixpkgs inputs is the intended package target, even if upstream publishes a newer release first.
assumptions.falsifier: The user requires exact upstream ast-grep 0.50.0 rather than the latest package in Nixpkgs.

assumptions.statement: The replacement Home Manager Zsh option paths preserve the semantics of the old enabled flags.
assumptions.falsifier: Evaluation or activation shows autosuggestions or syntax highlighting disabled or unavailable.

plane_constraints: Keep the Home Manager target to cc-se-sto-devbox-01; do not activate other profiles.
